title: 2.0 BLOCKER - remove the nvidia-pid ModelDef once the PiD plugins ship
description:
UMBRELLA: MPI-553 - Upscalers leave the model picker, as plugins (project-refresh consolidation sweep 2026-08-13). Members and phase order: tasks/MPI-553/plan.md.

PiD carries the deprecation badge from 1.4 (MPI-514). This card is the other half: on 2.0 the ModelDef leaves models.js and the Model Library, replaced by the four upscale-dropdown plugins MPI-507 builds. Blocked by MPI-506 (plugin dropdown mechanism) -> MPI-507 (the PiD migration): a removal cannot land before the replacement exists. HARD RULE: do NOT delete the pid-* / vae-* / pid-gemma entries from the dep files. _orphanedDepIds in routes/downloadManager.js walks DEPS and can only reclaim a weight that still has an entry - delete it and the file strands on existing users' disks forever, untracked, with nothing in the app able to remove it. MPI-470 and MPI-466 both kept theirs. 2.0 must not ship with the ModelDef still in the picker AND the plugins live - that is two ways to install the same 16GB of weights, which is the whole reason for the split.
